A prayer most people know, and almost nobody uses.

Kevin Trudeau says the hack is to keep your eye on the dream and not resist the problem. He points to the serenity prayer as a mantra that belongs in your home, repeated over and over.

It asks for the patience to accept what you cannot change, the courage to change what you can, and the wisdom to know the difference.

Which of those three do you need most right now?
